common.wakingUp: Waking up the database — the first request after a quiet period can take about 10 seconds…
common.networkError: Couldn't reach the server. Please try again.
common.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

errors.invalid_url: Please enter a link starting with https://
errors.invalid_youtube: That doesn't look like a YouTube link.
errors.TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS: Too many attempts. Please wait 15 minutes and try again.
errors.TEMP_PASSWORD_EXPIRED: This temporary password has expired. Ask the Owner for a new one.
errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session ended. Please sign in again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You don't have permission to do that.

errors.CONFLICT: An item with the same unique value already exists.

password.forcedIntro: For security, you need to change the temporary password before you can use the admin panel.
password.min_length: have at least 12 characters (a few words together works great)
password.same_as_current: be different from the current password
password.guessable: not be only site words like kotoha, clover, lily or password
password.leaked: not appear in known data leaks
password.changed: Password changed! You're signed in with the new password.

dashboard.intro: Here you can manage everything that appears on the fan site.
dashboard.analyticsSoon: Visitor statistics will appear here soon.

videos.title: Latest Videos
videos.hint: The newest date is shown first. The newest video is featured on the home screen.

news.title: News
news.hint: The two newest items appear on the home screen.

achievements.title: Achievements
achievements.hint: Shown in the Discography section, newest first.

discography.title: Discography

fields.youtubeHelp: Paste the video link — the title fills in automatically.
fields.title: Title
fields.headline: Headline

content.archiveConfirm: Move “{label}” to the archive? It disappears from the site, and you can restore it from the Archive.

gallery.title: Gallery
gallery.hint: Every artwork needs the artist's name and, if possible, the link where it was posted.
gallery.formats: JPEG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, GIF or HEIC. Big files are shrunk automatically.
gallery.author: Artist name
gallery.shrunk: Resized to fit the 10 MB / 25 MP limit
gallery.heicTooBig: This HEIC photo is too big to shrink in this browser. Please save it as JPEG and try again.
gallery.deleteConfirm: Permanently delete this image? The file is removed from Cloudinary to save space (its credit record stays in the Archive).

archive.title: Archive
archive.hint: Everything that was removed from the site. Restore brings an item back exactly as it was.
archive.restoreDone: Restored! It's back in its section.

accounts.title: Accounts
accounts.hint: Only the Owner can manage accounts. Admins have the same content powers as the Owner.
accounts.createdInfo: Give these to the new admin. The temporary password is shown only once and expires in 7 days. They must choose their own password at first sign-in.
accounts.resetConfirm: Give {name} a new temporary password? They will be signed out.
accounts.removeConfirm: Remove {name}? They will be signed out and can no longer sign in. (A record stays in the Archive.)
